meta.source: nflverse depth_charts, the whole league rather than the pool
caveats: A depth chart is what a team publishes, not what it does. It is a claim about intent, and a coach who lists a rookie second is not obliged to play him second.
Skill positions only. A waiver claim is never about a guard.
Ranked by the team's own ordering; a player the chart does not rank is listed last rather than first.
